what_this_is: Temperature-scaling calibration of asafe51/plantdoc-disease-classifier, measured on the same 215 PlantDoc TEST field photos as disease_field_eval.json.
problem: The model is underconfident: mean top-1 probability was 0.60 even on correct answers, so correct diagnoses were routinely shown to users as ~38-50%.
method: softmax(logits / T). T fitted by minimising NLL, 5-fold cross-validation (T fitted on 4 folds, scored on the 5th). Argmax is unchanged, so top-1 (73.0%) and top-3 (94.4%) accuracy are identical.

rejected_idea_embedding_memory.idea: Learn instantly from tester corrections by storing each corrected photo's ViT embedding and letting the nearest stored example override or blend with the model.
rejected_idea_embedding_memory.result: No gain or a loss under 5-fold CV. Best blend 74.4% top-1 vs 73.0% baseline (within noise); memory alone 65.6-68.8%; similarity-gated override 66.0-73.0%. The model's CLS embeddings barely separate classes (median nearest same-class cosine 0.66 vs 0.60 for other classes), so a neighbour lookup mostly adds noise.
rejected_idea_embedding_memory.conclusion: Feedback must improve the model by retraining, not by a lookup table.

known_gap: PlantDoc has only 2 training photos of 'Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf' (vs 44-140 for other tomato classes) and none in its test split, so that class is effectively unlearned and cannot be measured. This is the class tester feedback should target first.

retrained_head.what: app/ml/disease/retrain.py retrains only the final Linear(768->28) layer on frozen ViT features of the PlantDoc TRAIN split (2,342 photos), class-balanced, L2-anchored to the published head. Hyperparameters fixed in advance, not tuned on TEST.

feedback_simulation.setup: Half of each class's PlantDoc TEST photos used as simulated tester corrections, the other half scored; halves swapped, 5 random splits (10 runs).
feedback_simulation.result: Adding the simulated feedback to the PlantDoc-train retrain did not help: 78.0% -> 77.1% (-0.9pt, worse in 9/10 runs) at feedback weights 1, 5 and 20.
feedback_simulation.interpretation: Extra photos of classes PlantDoc already covers well add nothing. Feedback can only help on classes PlantDoc lacks (spider mites: 2 training photos) and on real photos from this app's users — which is why retrain.py only uses feedback when it beats the plain retrain, cross-validated on the tester's own photos.
